summary: Verified all 6 revisions on TWMS Internal module (iter9). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed covering GET /api/internal/pembelian/seri-check (exists true/false, exclude_id, case-insensitive, empty), penjualan/lookup 'sudah terjual' error path, dashboard history endpoint with wide date range, and assistant.py 'koli' wording. Frontend (Playwright, admin/admin123, PJM warehouse): Dashboard 'Ringkasan Per Hari' table has data-testid=dashboard-days-paginator plus next/prev buttons and shows day rows; wording uses 'koli' and no visible 'lembar'. Pembelian form Enter-on-duplicate shows DuplicateDialog with 'Nomor seri ... sudah pernah diinput' message, clears the seri input, and renders duplicate-dialog-ok button correctly. Out and Revisi pages expose all three search inputs (seri/bandul/jadi) with the specified testids. Penjualan autosave writes to localStorage key twms-jual-draft-<wh> while typing, and after full page reload + reopening the Tambah form, the previously typed gulungan/pembeli/seri values are restored; clicking 'Kembali' clears the draft key.
critical_code_review_comments: Pembelian.onSeriEnter swallows all errors from seri-check (bare catch{}); genuine network failures become silent and the user may unknowingly save a duplicate. Consider surfacing non-409 errors.
Penjualan draft autosave runs on every rows/gulungan/pembeli change without debouncing; fine today (small payload) but could be throttled if rows grow close to the 50 max.

Dashboard history query fetches with date_from=2000-01-01; for warehouses with large historical data this will scan all pembelian — consider adding a server-side 'latest N days' endpoint or indexed limit.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Autosave draft in localStorage was cleared via 'Kembali'. No pembelian/penjualan rows created on server.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://twms-move.preview.emergentagent.com. Login admin/admin123. Internal warehouse selector testid=internal-warehouse-select (PJM has data). Dashboard history testids: dashboard-days-paginator, dashboard-days-next, dashboard-days-prev, dashboard-day-<YYYY-MM-DD>, dashboard-day-filter. Pembelian duplicate flow uses DuplicateDialog (duplicate-dialog, duplicate-dialog-message, duplicate-dialog-ok). Penjualan draft key: twms-jual-draft-<wh id>. Backend seri-check endpoint: GET /api/internal/pembelian/seri-check?wh=&seri=&exclude_id= (upper-cases + case-insensitive match). Only one day of historical pembelian exists in PJM so the paginator UI only shows '1/1' — to visually verify pagination with multiple pages, add pembelian rows across different tanggal_beli values.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 6 revisions implement to spec.
